annotation.interpretation_a: The server cancels requests on streams *strictly* higher than the last Stream ID in the GOAWAY. Stream ID equal to the last Stream ID is unaffected.
annotation.interpretation_b: The server cancels requests on streams greater than or equal to the last Stream ID in the GOAWAY. Stream ID equal to the last Stream ID is also cancelled.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'higher than' is ambiguous. Does it include the indicated last Stream ID, or only those strictly above it? Both interpretations are reasonable and lead to different implementation behaviours.
